title: Longitudinal Monitoring of LLM Content Moderation of Social Issues

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM refusal rates by prompting models to repeat neutral Wikipedia text about 421 social and political issues, tracking how content moderation and censorship change longitudinally across different geopolitical topics (e.g., Israel-Gaza conflict, abortion, Chinese sensitive topics, and U.S. political figures).

Comparing LLM content moderation, refusal rates, and non-explicit refusal strategies when the models are prompted to repeat the exact same sensitive Wikipedia content translated into English versus Chinese.

Analyzing the differences in moderation behavior and topic sensitivity between models developed in a U.S. cultural context (OpenAI's GPT series) and models developed in a Chinese cultural context (DeepSeek).
